description: Bellarine Peninsula 1% AEP Coastal Inundation Dynamic Model with 0.8m Sea Level Rise (series on Victorian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The Bellarine-Corio Bay Local Coastal Hazard Assessment (LCHA) provides information on the extent of coastal hazards and their physical impacts for the Bellarine-Corio Bay coastal environment. Dynamic inundation modelling was carried out to create this data layer for 1% Annual Exceedance Probability (AEP) coastal inundation under the assumption of 0. Coverage: Victoria. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are  atmosphere,  meteorology, Climatology, Environment, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
